Sub ShStatus() Dim NV_bits As UShort Dim AH_Status As Short Dim ST_Status As Short body.fill_opacity = 0.35 Repair_mode.visibility = "hidden" If OU != Nothing Then If ((OU.SuspendedFlags & PLS_SUSP_CMD) != 0) Then AStat = 0 Repair_mode.visibility = "visible" Col_AH = 6 'CFG_COLOR_REMONT body.fill_opacity = 1 Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" Exit Sub End If End If If (Z0.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then NV_bits = Z0.Value & 0x3C0 If ((NV_bits & 0xC0) > 0) Then AH_Status = -1 Else AH_Status = (Z0.Value & 1) * 2 + (Z0.Value & 2) * 4 End If If ((NV_bits & 0x300) > 0) Then ST_Status = -1 Else ST_Status = (Z0.Value & 4) * 8 + (Z0.Value & 8) * 32 End If Else AH_Status = 0 ST_Status = 0 End If If (Z1.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then If AH_Status != -1 Then AH_Status = Z1.Value & 0xF End If If ST_Status != -1 Then ST_Status = Z1.Value & 0x3F0 End If AStat = (Z1.Value & 0xC00) / 0x400 Else If (AH_Status == 0) Then AH_Status = -1 End If If (ST_Status == 0) Then ST_Status = -1 End If End If
If (AH_Status == -1)Then 'недостоверность Col_AH = 15 'CFG_COLOR_INVALID body.fill_opacity = 1 ElseIf ((AH_Status & 0xE) == 0x2) Then Col_AH = 2 ElseIf ((AH_Status & 0xE) == 0x4) Then Col_AH = 3 | 0x40 ElseIf ((AH_Status & 0xE) == 0x8) Then Col_AH = 3 Else Col_AH = 15 body.fill_opacity = 1 End If If (ST_Status == -1)Then Col_ST = 0 Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.text = "X" ElseIf ((ST_Status & 0x3F0) == 0x10) Then If StopStart Then Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "visible" Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.text = "2" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" End If Col_ST = 0x40 ElseIf ((ST_Status & 0x3F0) == 0x20) Then If StopStart Then Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "visible" Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.text = "2" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" End If Col_ST = 0 ElseIf ((ST_Status & 0x3F0) == 0x40) Then If StopStart Then Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "visible" Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.text = "2" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" End If Col_ST = 0x10 ElseIf ((ST_Status & 0x3F0) == 0x80) Then If StopStart Then Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" Progr_start.visibility = "visible" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.text = "1" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" End If Col_ST = 0x40 ElseIf ((ST_Status & 0x3F0) == 0x100) Then If StopStart Then Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" Progr_start.visibility = "visible" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.text = "1" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" End If Col_ST = 0 ElseIf ((ST_Status & 0x3F0) == 0x200) Then If StopStart Then Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" Progr_start.visibility = "visible" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.text = "1" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" End If Col_ST = 0x10 Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" End If End Sub

Sub ShGroups() Dim GR_Status As Short If OU != Nothing Then If ((OU.SuspendedFlags & PLS_SUSP_CMD) != 0) Then HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_1, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_2, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_3, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_4, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_5, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_6, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_7, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_8, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_9, False) Exit Sub End If End If If (Z4.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then GR_Status = Z4.Value If ((GR_Status & 0x1) > 0) Then HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_1, True) Else HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_1, False) End If If ((GR_Status & 0x2) > 0) Then HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_2, True) Else HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_2, False) End If If ((GR_Status & 0x4) > 0) Then HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_3, True) Else HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_3, False) End If If ((GR_Status & 0x8) > 0) Then HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_4, True) Else HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_4, False) End If If ((GR_Status & 0x10) > 0) Then HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_5, true) Else HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_5, False) End If If ((GR_Status & 0x20) > 0) Then HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_6, True) Else HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_6, False) End If If ((GR_Status & 0x40) > 0) Then HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_7, True) Else HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_7, False) End If If ((GR_Status & 0x80) > 0) Then HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_8, True) Else HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_8, False) End If If ((GR_Status & 0x100) > 0) Then HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_9, True) Else HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_9, False) End If Else HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_1, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_2, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_3, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_4, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_5, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_6, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_7, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_8, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_9, False) End If End Sub

Sub ShGroupFrames() Dim GR_frame_Status As Short If OU != Nothing Then If ((OU.SuspendedFlags & PLS_SUSP_CMD) != 0) Then Col_Fr_1 = 10 'нулевая палитра = Col_Grey3 Col_Fr_2 = 10 Col_Fr_3 = 10 Col_Fr_4 = 10 Col_Fr_5 = 10 Col_Fr_6 = 10 Col_Fr_7 = 10 Col_Fr_8 = 10 Col_Fr_9 = 10 Exit Sub End If End If If (Z2.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then GR_frame_Status = Z2.Value If ((GR_frame_Status & 0x10) > 0) Then Col_Fr_1 = 0x40 'нулевая палитра = мигающий Black ElseIf ((GR_frame_Status & 0x20) > 0) Then Col_Fr_1 = 0 'нулевая палитра = black Else Col_Fr_1 = 10 'нулевая палитра = Col_Grey3 End If If ((GR_frame_Status & 0x40) > 0) Then Col_Fr_2 = 0x40 ElseIf ((GR_frame_Status & 0x80) > 0) Then Col_Fr_2 = 0 Else Col_Fr_2 = 10 End If If ((GR_frame_Status & 0x100) > 0) Then Col_Fr_3 = 0x40 ElseIf ((GR_frame_Status & 0x200) > 0) Then Col_Fr_3 = 0 Else Col_Fr_3 = 10 End If If ((GR_frame_Status & 0x400) > 0) Then Col_Fr_4 = 0x40 ElseIf ((GR_frame_Status & 0x800) > 0) Then Col_Fr_4 = 0 Else Col_Fr_4 = 10 End If Else Col_Fr_1 = 10 Col_Fr_2 = 10 Col_Fr_3 = 10 Col_Fr_4 = 10 End If If (Z3.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then GR_frame_Status = Z3.Value If ((GR_frame_Status & 0x1) > 0) Then Col_Fr_5 = 0x40 ElseIf ((GR_frame_Status & 0x2) > 0) Then Col_Fr_5 = 0 Else Col_Fr_5 = 10 End If If ((GR_frame_Status & 0x4) > 0) Then Col_Fr_6 = 0x40 ElseIf ((GR_frame_Status & 0x8) > 0) Then Col_Fr_6 = 0 Else Col_Fr_6 = 10 End If If ((GR_frame_Status & 0x10) > 0) Then Col_Fr_7 = 0x40 ElseIf ((GR_frame_Status & 0x20) > 0) Then Col_Fr_7 = 0 Else Col_Fr_7 = 10 End If If ((GR_frame_Status & 0x40) > 0) Then Col_Fr_8 = 0x40 ElseIf ((GR_frame_Status & 0x80) > 0) Then Col_Fr_8 = 0 Else Col_Fr_8 = 10 End If If ((GR_frame_Status & 0x100) > 0) Then Col_Fr_9 = 0x40 ElseIf ((GR_frame_Status & 0x200) > 0) Then Col_Fr_9 = 0 Else Col_Fr_9 = 10 End If Else Col_Fr_5 = 10 Col_Fr_6 = 10 Col_Fr_7 = 10 Col_Fr_8 = 10 Col_Fr_9 = 10 End If
End Sub

Sub HighlightGrTxt(ByVal TxtObj As RtSvgObj, ByVal Highlight As Boolean) If Highlight Then TxtObj.fill = 0 TxtObj.font_size = 15 TxtObj.font_weight = "bold" Else TxtObj.fill = 0x505050 TxtObj.font_size = 10 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If (KKS != "NULL") Then Z0 = BIN(KKS + "_Z0") Z1 = BIN(KKS + "_Z1") Z2 = BIN(KKS + "_Z2") Z3 = BIN(KKS + "_Z3") Z4 = BIN(KKS + "_Z4") OU = BIN(KKS + "_OU") If GR_number > 9 Then GR_number = 9 End If End If If Z0 == Nothing Then Col_AH = 14 Col_ST = 14 body.fill_opacity = 1 HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_1, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_2, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_3, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_4, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_5, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_6, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_7, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_8, False) HighlightGrTxt(GR_work_9, False) End If
Al_frame.x = 2.5 Al_frame.y = 2.5 Al_frame.width = _This.width - 5 Al_frame.height = _This.height - 5 InGr.x = 0 InGr.y = 0 InGr.width = _This.width InGr.height = _This.height

rect.rt:event: If KKS == "NULL" Then ShowMessage ("Нет привязки.", 5) ElseIf Z0 != nothing Then Open_Win_Uni(False, "rights", "Права управления", "wi_rights", KKS + "|" + CStr(Operate)) Else NoLink(KKS) End If

If KKS == "NULL" Then ShowMessage ("Нет привязки.", 5) ElseIf Z0 != nothing Then Open_ws_wf_wi("TPTS_GS_6", KKS + "|" + CStr(GR_number) + "|" + CStr(StopStart), Operate) Else ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки.\nKKS = \"" + KKS, 0) End If

If KKS == "NULL" Then ShowMessage ("Нет привязки.", 5) ElseIf Z0 != nothing Then If Operate && Check_Oper_Rights(OU) Then LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + "|GS o|TPTS_GS_6 " + KKS + "|" + CStr(GR_number) + "|" + CStr(StopStart)) Else LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + "|GS i|TPTS_GS_6 " + KKS + "|" + CStr(GR_number) + "|" + CStr(StopStart)) End If Else ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки.\nKKS = \"" + KKS, 0) End If
